commands.command:
set -e; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/scripts/apply-climate-detail-unify-v1.py > /tmp/apply-climate-detail-unify-v1.py; python3 - <<'PY'
p='/tmp/apply-climate-detail-unify-v1.py'
lines=open(p).read().splitlines()
hits=[i for i,line in enumerate(lines) if line.strip().startswith('relay_end = text.find(')]
if len(hits) != 1: raise SystemExit(f'unexpected relay_end anchors: {hits}')
i=hits[0]
if 'relay_start' not in lines[i]: raise SystemExit('relay_end anchor does not reference relay_start')
lines[i]=lines[i].replace('relay_start','health_start',1)
open(p,'w').write('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
PY
python3 /tmp/apply-climate-detail-unify-v1.py; mkdir -p apps/mobile/src/components/icons; cat > apps/mobile/src/components/icons/CodeIcon.tsx <<'EOF'
import { IconCode } from '@tabler/icons-react';

export const CodeIcon = () => (
  <IconCode className="icon-action__svg" aria-hidden="true" />
);
EOF
python3 - <<'PY'
p='apps/mobile/src/components/AppBottomNavigation.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
old='        type="button"\n        aria-haspopup="dialog"'
new='        type="button"\n        data-dashboard-kind="settings"\n        aria-haspopup="dialog"'
if s.count(old) != 1: raise SystemExit(f'unexpected settings nav anchor count: {s.count(old)}')
open(p,'w').write(s.replace(old,new,1))
PY
